name: tesemble
description: Test GTM messaging and ICP hypotheses against a synthetic persona grid before real-world experiments.

interface.longDescription: Tesemble runs your product briefs and outbound copy against a factorial grid of synthetic buyer personas. Use it from ChatGPT to suggest audiences, run ICP discovery, validate GTM messages, compare variants, and read segment-level insights. Simulation spends credits on your connected Tesemble account; buying credits happens at app.tesemble.com.
defaultPrompt: Who does this landing page land with?
Test this cold email against a B2B founder grid.
Compare my last two message simulation runs.

positive.prompt: Use Tesemble to show my credit balance.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected user's credit balance without starting a paid simulation.

positive.description: Suggest an audience from a brief
positive.prompt: Suggest a persona grid for this B2B SaaS onboarding email.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a persona grid and idea card without charging reaction credits.

positive.prompt: Run an ICP discovery simulation on this one-line product pitch.
positive.expected_behavior: Complete the simulation and summarize which segments responded strongest.

positive.prompt: What saved audiences do I have in Tesemble?
positive.expected_behavior: List audiences on the reviewer test account.

positive.prompt: Suggest two alternate subject lines for this outbound email without running a simulation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return draft rewrites without starting a credit-charging run.

negative.prompt: Buy 50,000 Tesemble credits with my card here in chat.
Delete every saved audience in my account without asking.
